answer: Each hostel room is furnished with a cot, a chair, a table, and a cupboard. All other essentials must be brought by the student or purchased locally.

answer: Notebooks are available in campus shops, so you don't need to bring them from home.

answer: Hostel room allotment is random. Boys can choose between single or triple-sharing rooms. Girls can choose 4-in-1 or 5-in-1 sharing rooms in SPS or RLV hostels.

answer: Yes, hot water is available in the common restrooms. Note that first-year hostels feature only common restrooms.

question: What are the milk timings in the hostel? ? milk timings hostel ? when is milk distributed in hostel ? morning evening night milk timing in hostel
answer: Milk is distributed at the following timings: Morning from 6:00 AM to 8:00 AM, Evening from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM, and Night from 9:00 PM until the supply runs out.

question: How is hostel attendance taken and registered? ? biometric attendance hostel timing ? roll call timings boys and girls ? face recognition attendance start date ? is biometric attendance compulsory
answer: During the first two weeks of college, hostel attendance is taken manually. After that, hostel attendance is registered biometrically and is mandatory. answer: Girls' roll call is between 5:40 PM and 6:30 PM. On regular college days, if you need to go out after 4:30 PM or 5:00 PM (even to roam within campus), you must enter your details in the register. You must return before the roll call timings (preferably before 6:00 PM to avoid questioning).

question: What are the Sunday outing rules for girls within the campus? ? girls Sunday movement rules inside campus ? Sunday roll call for girls ? what time should girls return to hostel on Sundays
answer: On Sundays, if girls want to roam within the campus, they must sign the register when exiting and entering, and they must return to the hostel before 4:30 PM.

answer: Yes, boys can go out on weekends after signing the outing register. They must return before the 8:30 PM roll call.

question: How do I apply for multiple leaves during a semester? ? how to apply for leave in SWI ? PWI SWI leave limit ? how to take permission for more than two leaves ? DOSA leave approval

question: What is the procedure for girls going home on holidays? ? girls home leave permission process ? letter format for girls going home ? facial recognition for girls leave
answer: Girls going home must submit a physical letter (format available in the hostel), undergo facial recognition, and apply in the online portal.

question: What are the daily class timings and daily workload for a first-year B.Tech student? ? class hours per day for 1st year ? college start and end time ? daily schedule for BTech freshers

question: What is the etiquette for bunking classes? ? how to bunk responsibly ? bunking class rules ? walking out of class etiquette

answer: You can reduce the 3 required open electives by taking ACRS (Advanced Credit Registration System) from the 4th semester onwards or by doing a Minor specialization.

answer: You can borrow sports equipment from the Student Activity Centre (SAC) by depositing your student ID card.

question: When is the orientation programme for first-year students and is it compulsory? ? orientation dates 2026 ? is orientation mandatory ? two day orientation August 3 and 4 ? can I skip orientation
answer: A two-day orientation is scheduled on August 3 and 4, 2026 for all first-year B.Tech and M.Tech (Intg.) students. It is compulsory. Students are advised to reach the orientation venue and occupy their seats well before the start time.

question: Are there rules about hairstyle on campus? ? hair rules SASTRA ? long hair in laboratory ? beard and moustache rule for boys ? grooming rules in campus

question: When do regular classes start and how do I find my section and timetable? ? class commencement date 2026 ? where to check section allotment ? first year timetable SASTRA ? how do I know which section I am in

question: What should I complete in the first week to get my student ID card? ? photo session for ID card ? how to get student ID card SASTRA ? CUB SB account opening for freshers ? student ID despatch process

question: Where and when should I submit my Transfer Certificate (TC)? ? original transfer certificate submission ? where to submit TC at SASTRA ? document verification session documents ? how to download bonafide letter

question: Who can help me on campus during the opening days if I am confused? ? SCOS SASTRA ? student volunteers opening day ? who to approach for help on 2 August ? Student Citizens of SASTRA
answer: Student Citizens of SASTRA (SCOS) volunteers are deputed for assistance on August 02 and 03, 2026. They wear bands or caps for easy identification, and you should not hesitate to approach them for any support.

answer: For first-year B.Tech and M.Tech (Intg.) students, lab examinations start on 30 November 2026 and the odd semester end semester examinations start on 07 December 2026.

question: What are the exam fee remittance dates for first years in the odd semester? ? exam fee payment date 2026 ? when to pay exam fee first semester ? release of exam schedule date ? nominal roll release date first year
answer: For first-year students in the 2026-27 odd semester, exam fee remittance starts on 12 October 2026, the exam schedule is released on 26 October 2026, the last date for exam fee remittance with fine is 20 November 2026, and the nominal roll is released on 23 November 2026.

question: When does the even semester start for the 2026-27 first-year batch? ? second semester start date ? even semester commencement first year ? when do classes resume in January 2027 ? even semester schedule first year
answer: For first-year B.Tech and M.Tech (Intg.) students, the even semester begins on 04 January 2027. CIA I falls on 2-5 February 2027, CIA II on 10-13 March 2027, and CIA III on 26-29 April 2027. question: When is the arrear examination held after the first year even semester? ? arrear exam date 2027 ? odd semester arrear exam schedule ? when can I clear backlog subjects ? supplementary exam date first year

question: What are the holidays in the 2026-27 odd semester? ? holiday list odd semester 2026 ? festival holidays SASTRA 2026 ? when is Deepavali holiday 2026 ? list of holidays first semester

question: What are the holidays in the 2026-27 even semester? ? holiday list even semester 2027 ? Pongal holiday dates 2027 ? when is Tamil New Year holiday ? second semester holidays SASTRA

question: When are Daksh, Kuruksastra and Colosseum scheduled in 2026-27? ? fest dates 2027 SASTRA ? when is Daksh 2027 ? Kuruksastra date 2027 ? Colosseum sports fest date

question: Why do we have classes on some Saturdays, and how does that work? ? Saturday working day SASTRA ? why is Saturday a working day ? Saturday follows which timetable ? compensatory working Saturday
answer: Some Saturdays are declared working days to compensate for holidays that fall on weekdays. On such days the timetable of another weekday is followed, and the academic calendar states which day it is, for example a Saturday marked as Friday means the Friday timetable is used. Attendance on these days counts exactly as on any other working day.

question: What is the minimum attendance required to write the end semester examination? ? 75 percent attendance rule SASTRA ? attendance requirement for exams ? minimum attendance per course ? attendance rule 2026
answer: Under the examination regulations effective 28 January 2026, a minimum of 75% attendance in each course is required to appear for the end semester examinations. The requirement is applied course by course, not on your overall average, so falling short in a single subject affects that subject.

question: What happens if my attendance falls below 75 percent under the 2026 rules? ? attendance condonation SASTRA 2026 ? shortage of attendance what to do ? condonation fee attendance ? attendance below 70 percent consequences
answer: The 2026 regulations use a graded system. Between 70% and 75% you may write the exam by paying a condonation fee for each such course. Between 65% and 70% you pay a condonation fee and a caution deposit. Between 60% and 65% you must additionally attend special classes to make up the deficiency, besides paying the condonation fee and caution deposit.

question: What happens if my attendance drops below 60 percent in a course? ? MOOC option for attendance shortage ? attendance below 60 percent SASTRA ? NPTEL course for attendance deficiency ? cumulative attendance below 50 percent
answer: If attendance in a course is below 60% but your cumulative attendance is 50% or above, you must complete an approved MOOC (NPTEL) course in the following semester, paying the condonation fee and caution deposit. If cumulative attendance across all courses falls below 50%, you cannot write the end semester examinations at all and must redo that semester in the following academic year.

question: Does poor attendance affect my hostel accommodation? ? hostel eligibility attendance rule ? can I lose hostel for low attendance ? hostel renewal attendance requirement ? 100 percent attendance expectation hostellers
answer: Yes. Renewal of hostel stay for the next academic year is not automatic and depends on discipline, behaviour and class attendance. Hostellers are expected to maintain full attendance, and consistently poor attendance can make a student ineligible for hostel accommodation.

question: How are marks split between internal assessment and the end semester exam? ? CIA and end semester weightage ? internal marks percentage SASTRA ? 50 50 weightage rule ? how is total mark calculated
answer: SASTRA follows continuous assessment and end semester assessment with 50% weightage each for engineering and most other programmes, graded on a 10-point scale with CGPA calculated from it.
